sn45.160:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā.
sn45.160:1.3: mayaṃ imaṃ gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ karissāma pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn45.160:1.5: api nu so mahājanakāyo taṃ gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ kareyya pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti?
sn45.160:1.8: gaṅgā bhante, nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā.
sn45.160:1.9: sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.
sn45.160:1.10: yāvadeva ca pana so mahājanakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
sn45.160:1.11: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāventaṃ ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarontaṃ rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ.
sn45.160:1.12: ehambho purisa, kinte ime kāsāvā anudahanti,
sn45.160:1.14: ehi. hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu. puññāni ca karohī’ti.
sn45.160:1.15: so vata bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatteyyāti. netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn45.160:1.17: yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave, cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ. taṃ vata hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn45.160:1.18: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.160:1.19: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti, vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.160:1.20: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
